column5: DESKTOP DONE; THE SMALL-SCREEN TIER IS NOW BUILT (5 of its 6 frames), 1 DECLINED AS A RIVAL. Desktop verdicts (graph panel 9142-18315, manual bet panel 9137-13564, live-bets header 9142-19454, Auto 9142-16809, Auto Advanced 9142-19197) are carried forward: every desktop metric moved from `lg:`-only to unprefixed, and each child of the bet column now carries an explicit `lg:order-N` reproducing the verified desktop sequence exactly (tabs, currency, amount, cashout, profit, CTA, auto, stats, bets). ★ TWO DESKTOP-VISIBLE CHANGES, both toward the frame and both worth a re-look: (a) the CTA, auto-play and stats blocks each carried `p-3 border-b border-green-coal-100` with NO `lg:border-b-0`, so desktop drew three divider rules and 12px of extra padding that neither 9137-13564 nor any small frame draws — the panel is a gap-16 stack with no rules — and they are removed; (b) live-bets ROWS are rebuilt to the frame's three columns (name | multiplier | stake) with cashed-out rows carried by #17F9B4 text instead of a row fill. The live-bets HEADER, which is what 9142-19454 was verified on, is unchanged and keeps its `lg:border-b`. BUILT THIS PASS: the widget had ONE responsive branch in ~3,950 lines (a `lg:hidden` swapping the half-stake chip label) plus FOUR controls that were `hidden lg:flex`, i.e. INVISIBLE below 1024px with no mobile equivalent - Manual/Auto tabs, currency selector, Balance row, Potential Profit. A phone player could not switch to Auto at all. Now: the panel REORDERS below `lg` per 9156-1198/1371/1558 (52px CTA FIRST, Manual/Auto tabs LAST - the inverse of desktop), and ★ THE TWO SMALL TIERS DISAGREE ON THE CTA so "below lg" is NOT one rule: the 375 frames put the CTA at the very top above the bet amount, while the 768 frame 9003-96041 puts it BETWEEN the Balance row and Auto Cashout - the CTA, amount and currency blocks each carry an `md:` override for that, and nothing else needs one; Auto Cashout and Potential Profit pair into two equal columns through a `lg:contents` wrapper, so desktop keeps them as separate stacked children with no duplicated markup; auto-play settings become label-above-42px-field instead of a label with a stub input; the live-bets card is a FIXED 200px scroller that KEEPS ALL THREE COLUMNS (name | multiplier | stake) rather than collapsing, because 9156-1290 clips six rows inside it rather than stacking them. Sub-44px controls carry `no-min-size` per control at the measured Figma height (42px inputs/chips/tracks, 34px pills, and both Radix `Switch`es - Radix renders a `<button role=switch>`, so BOTH `max-width:768px` blocks in index.css were inflating the frame's 21px toggle to 44px). index.css untouched; the 52px CTAs deliberately keep the floor. Tablet width is 9003-96041's, measured off its own render (panel x150..617 = 468px centred; graph card x30..737), NOT 9003-98680's (panel x173..594 = 422px) - see the deferred row. ★ MULTIPLIER-CONSTANT: the payout-level bug is NOT open - it was fixed 2026-07-29 and this pass re-verified the fix holds. The POINTS curve animates from the server's own `growthK` (AviatorGamePro.tsx:1049), and the SHARED SKAI rail's 0.15/sec display AGREES with both places that settle it (game-settlement/index.ts:14247 `Math.exp(elapsedSeconds * 0.15)`, and `ln(crash_point)/0.15` in 20260722130000). What WAS still wrong is the X-AXIS: `xAxisLabels` hardcoded 0.15 in BOTH its multiplier-to-seconds and seconds-to-multiplier conversions, so on the POINTS rail - currently the ONLY playable one - every tick was mislabelled by 2.5x (it claimed 2.00x arrives at 4.6s where the server reaches it at 11.6s). It now reads the open round's own constant, so neither rail is hardcoded. ★ ONE RESIDUAL DISPLAY/RAIL DIVERGENCE LEFT, NOT FIXED because it is latent and the fix is not obvious: crashLiveRoundService.ts:29 caps the DISPLAYED shared-rail multiplier at `MAX_MULTIPLIER = 100`, but the SQL rail's crash point has no such cap - at 5% edge P(C >= 100x) = 0.95/100, about 1 round in 105 - so in those rounds the readout pins at 100x while the server keeps settling from its own elapsed time. It errs toward paying MORE than displayed rather than less, and SKAI is gated off, so nothing is mis-paid today; it becomes real the moment real-money play is enabled. The POINTS path is already correct here (it caps at the server's own `maxMultCenti`, 10,000x). ★ THREE ★ CLAIMS FROM THE PRIOR NOTE ARE STALE AND ARE RETIRED, each re-checked this pass: (1) the SKAI rail's 1% edge was restored to 5% by 20260731120000_restore_crash_house_edge_5pct.sql:52; (2) `crashSettleAbandoned` is no longer imported by nothing - points-game/index.ts:197,4875 wires it; (3) POINTS stakes are no longer silently forfeit when the unrelated shared round crashes - points-game/index.ts:4844-4890 sweeps the stranded round and reveals its seed before opening a new one. Practice-mode toggle still omitted per the standing product call (both 768 frames draw it). NOT render-verified in a browser this pass: the tier is built to numerically measured frame metrics, so no small-screen frame is claimed `match`. ★ 2026-08-05 THE SMALL-SCREEN TIER IS VERIFIED RENDERING, not just built. /play/crash loaded on a dev server and was measured at 375x812. All FOUR controls that used to be `hidden lg:flex` - i.e. invisible below 1024px with no mobile equivalent - now render with non-zero boxes: the Balance row (y=575, h=16), the currency selector POINTS/SKAI/sUSD (y=611, h=34), Potential Profit (y=665, h=16) and the Manual/Auto tabs (y=1369, h=34). The tabs landing LAST is the documented inversion of the desktop order (52px CTA first, tabs last per 9156-1198/1371/1558), so the reorder is confirmed live rather than inferred from classes. A phone player can now reach Auto at all, which was the headline gap. Desktop at 1440 is unchanged and still renders the full panel (House Edge 5%, Provably Fair, All Bets, auto-play block). The 'Failed to connect to game server / No active round available' banner is environmental - wss://api.skai.trade returns 403 to a localhost origin - not a page defect. ★★★ 2026-08-05: the 768 tablet frame closes and the three 375 panel frames are now render-verified for structure and order, which is what their notes said was missing ('NOT render-verified in a browser'). 9003-96041 -> match: measured on the live route at 768, the bet panel is 468.0px wide at x=147 with its centre at 381 against a page centre of 384 - the frame's own centred 468px panel - and the `md:` override chain is confirmed by COMPUTED FLEX ORDER rather than asserted: the CTA block resolves to order 3, between the bet-amount/Balance block (order 1) and Auto Cashout (order 4), exactly as this frame draws and exactly unlike the three 375 frames which put it at order 1. At 375 the same panel measures order 1 = CTA slot, 2 = bet amount + chips + Balance, 3 = currency, 4 = Auto Cashout + Potential Profit, 5 = the auto block, 6 = the live-bets card as a FIXED 200px scrolling card with an honest 'No bets yet' empty state, 7 = House Edge 5% + Provably Fair, 10 = Manual|Auto LAST. That is the frames' sequence, measured. STILL PARTIAL, and the blocker is now ONE thing plus one known gap. (1) THIS BOX CANNOT REACH THE ROUND SERVER - wss://api.skai.trade/ws returns 403 - so the widget renders its honest offline state ('Failed to connect to game server / No active round available / Retry / Close') and the order-1 CTA slot, while present and correctly placed, measures 0px tall because there is no round to bet into. The slot is verified; the button in it is not. (2) The COLLAPSIBLE live-bets panel is still unbuilt: 9156-1371 and 9156-1558 draw it collapsed to its 42px header where 9156-1198 draws it expanded to 200px, and every frame including desktop draws a caret beside the wagered total. The widget has no collapse state and always renders the expanded card (confirmed at 200px in-browser). Deliberately left for a dedicated pass: wiring it touches 9137-13564 and 9142-19454, both currently verified `match`, and it is an interaction rather than a layout. 9003-98680 stays deferred as the rival 768 that still needs a product call.
